Whether you’re struggling with depression, anxiety, addiction, or PTSD, we can help. We’re committed to providing various mental health treatment programs to help each client on their own individual journey of self-discovery and transformation.

Through our evidence-based approaches and compassionate, client-centered philosophies, Garden Springs Wellness Center offers Tri-State area residents access to high-quality, personalized mental health treatment at our modern facilities. Not what you think of when you think “treatment”

We pride ourselves on creating an environment where our clients feel comfortable during their time with us. Our modern facilities offer spaces where our clients feel safe to explore the root causes of their mental health issues. We also offer supportive housing located minutes from our clinical location.

When you choose one of our mental health treatment programs, you can expect a transformative experience in wellness & healing. Our facilities were designed with your ultimate comfort & security in mind. Through our modern facilities and luxury amenities, we provide you with a variety of comforts that make your stay at Garden Springs Wellness feel like your home away from home.

A New Approach to Mental Healthcare.
Our Approach to Treating Mental Health

Our treatment program was hand-crafted by the top mental health professionals in the TriState area offering you the latest advancements in mental healthcare. Our interventional approach to mental health treatment combines traditional treatments with cutting-edge therapies in order to provide you with the most effective mental health treatment available in the TriState area. Our expert team of experienced doctors, clinicians, and mental health professionals are here to help you on your journey to mental health & wellness.
A Special Place Where Healing Happens

We know that it can be overwhelming seeking help for yourself or a loved one. We’ve made it easy to find the best treatment options that work for you. We do the work to find the right treatment programs that meet your needs.

Get Immediate Help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
Listen, we get it. We understand that reaching out for help can feel overwhelming, whether it’s you or a loved one seeking help.

We ensure that every single person who contacts us will receive care and compassion throughout their initial conversation. We additionally offer a secure texting line that allows you to text with someone who gets what you’re going through. Feel free to call or text us 24 hours a day, 7 days a week—no matter what.
